verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a legal services firm, not a software platform that stores user data behind self-service retention or deletion controls, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Its Privacy & Data Security practice advises clients on privacy laws such as the CCPA and GDPR. That legal counsel is an adjacent service, not a user-facing retention control, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
